traits.label: Face
traits.description: A die's face refers to its visible number, and not its total final value.

traits.label: Destroy
traits.description: A destroyed die is permanently deleted from your bag. This action always happens at the end of the turn.

traits.label: Discard
traits.description: A discarded die instantly disappears from the table, not triggering its effects nor giving pips.

traits.label: Extra value
traits.description: A die's extra value will be added to its face value when rolled. Disappears when the round ends.

traits.label: Charge
traits.description: A charged die gains +1 charge when rolled. If it's fully charged, it triggers its effect and its charges go back to 0.

traits.label: Ghost
traits.description: A ghost die is one-time use only and doesn't count as a die in your bag.

traits.label: Exhaust
traits.description: An exhausted die won't appear again during this round.

traits.label: Stamp multiplier
traits.description: Stamp multipliers are global multipliers that are permanently upgraded throughout the run and affect every die that rolled that face.

traits.label: Burn
traits.description: A burnt die will be multiplied by 0 but will still activate its effects nonetheless.

traits.label: Randomize
traits.description: A randomized die will transform into a different one until the end of the roll.

traits.label: Negative
traits.description: A negative die will subtract its value instead of adding it.

traits.label: Odd / even
traits.description: Even numbers are 2, 4, 6, 8, etc. Odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, 7, etc. Number 0 isn't considered odd nor even.

traits.label: Prime
traits.description: A prime number is only divisible by itself and 1. (2, 3, 5, 7, 11, etc.)

traits.label: Fibonacci
traits.description: The Fibonacci sequence is: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, etc.

traits.label: Choose face
traits.description: Choose face: Choose a die and lock any face as its result next roll.

traits.label: Active
traits.description: The Active symbol indicates that the ring will stop the roll and let you choose a die to trigger its effect with.

traits.label: Face weight
traits.description: Face Weights make dice more likely to roll a specific face.

traits.label: Odd faces
traits.description: Every face of this die is an odd number.

traits.label: Even faces
traits.description: Every face of this die is an even number.

traits.label: Face 0
traits.description: Its face is 0, so what it does comes from its effect.

traits.label: Variable face
traits.description: Its face is calculated from something else instead of being a fixed number.

traits.label: Single face
traits.description: A die with one single face.

traits.label: Huge
traits.description: A die with a huge number of faces.

traits.label: Nearby dice
traits.description: Its effect touches the dice next to it on the table.

traits.label: Gem
traits.description: A gem die.

traits.label: Countdown
traits.description: Triggers every few rolls.

traits.label: Growing value
traits.description: Gives pips based on a value that grows during the run.
